literal: the fox borrows the tiger's power
meaning_long: showing off or bullying with someone else's power
source: 《战国策·楚策一》 (public domain), retold in our own words.
cover: Every animal ran…\Nbut not from HIM.
hook: Everyone ran from him…\Nbut not because of HIM.
story: Ancient China, a misty mountain forest. A hungry tiger catches a fox. The clever fox says: 'You can't eat me! Heaven made me king of all animals. Don't believe me? Walk behind me and watch them run.' So the fox walks proudly in front and the tiger follows right behind. Every animal that sees them runs for its life. The tiger is amazed and lets the fox go, never realising the animals were running from the tiger, not the fox.
continuity: - THE FOX: slim red fox, orange-red fur, white chest, black-tipped ears and legs, big bushy tail with a white tip, narrow sly amber eyes, very expressive smug face. A real animal on four legs (no clothes) in the forest scenes.

- THE TIGER: huge tiger, orange fur with bold black stripes, white face markings, big paws, round expressive eyes (comic, never scary or bloody). A real animal on four legs (no clothes) in the forest scenes.
- OTHER ANIMALS (only in I1 and I6): a deer, a rabbit, a wild boar and a monkey, painted in the same style.
- SETTING: a misty mountain forest in ink-wash style: tall pines, mossy rocks, ferns, a winding dirt forest path.
scenes: The twist (used as the hook, first frame of the video)

The fox walks proudly along the forest path toward the viewer, chin up, tail high, smug half-closed eyes. Right behind him, the huge tiger follows, looking around in wonder. In the background, a deer, a rabbit, a wild boar and a monkey flee in panic into the trees. Both the fox's and the tiger's faces clear. This is the most important image; the editor will push in on it.
The tiger has pinned the fox to the ground under one huge paw, mouth open, licking his lips (no blood, comic). The fox's eyes are wide with shock, sweat drops flying.
Still under the tiger's paw, the fox suddenly puts on a proud, bossy face and points one front paw at the tiger's nose, as if scolding him. The tiger blinks, confused.
The tiger has lifted his paw and sits back, scratching his chin doubtfully. The fox stands, dusting himself off, and waves a paw grandly toward the forest path, inviting the tiger to follow.
Side view on the forest path: the fox struts in front with his tail held high like a flag; the huge tiger walks right behind him, curious. (Only the fox and the tiger.)

Wide shot: in a forest clearing, a deer, a rabbit, a wild boar and a monkey see the fox and the tiger coming and run away in panic, dust flying, eyes wide. The fox and the tiger are small in the background on the path.
Close-ish shot: the tiger stares after the fleeing animals with his jaw dropped, totally amazed. In front of him, the fox looks back over his shoulder at the viewer with a sly wink and a tiny smile.
The path (background for the big title)

The empty forest path from a low angle: in the lower half of the frame, two sets of footprints in the dirt, small fox prints next to huge tiger paw prints. The upper half is calm, misty pine forest with soft grey ink washes and almost nothing in it (we place the big title there). No animals.

An office: the same FOX, now standing on two legs in a slim orange suit, points bossily at two nervous office workers (plain modern clothes) at their desks. Right behind the fox, the same huge TIGER in a dark suit and tie stands looking down at his phone, not even paying attention. No text, no logos, no screens with writing.
lines: Everyone ran from him, but not because of him.
A hungry tiger caught a fox.
But the fox said: Stop! I'm the king of animals!
Don't believe me? Walk behind me and see.
So the fox walked in front, the tiger right behind.
Every animal ran for its life!
The tiger was amazed. The fox just smiled.
The fox borrows the tiger's power.
It means showing off with someone else's power.
Like acting tough… because the boss is right behind you.
title: Every animal ran from this fox… but not because of him 🦊🐯 | 狐假虎威
desc: 狐假虎威 (hú jiǎ hǔ wēi) = bullying with someone else's power. Know someone like that? 👇
pinned: 狐 fox · 假 borrow · 虎 tiger · 威 power. 📝 他仗着老板是他叔叔，到处狐假虎威。(Tā zhàngzhe lǎobǎn shì tā shūshu, dàochù hú jiǎ hǔ wēi.) = His uncle is the boss, so he bosses everyone around: the fox borrowing the tiger's power.
